summary: Zhihu Inc. filed a Form 6-K to announce its annual general meeting (AGM) set for June 30, 2026, in Beijing. The filing includes the notice of AGM, circular, and proxy forms for ordinary shareholders and ADS holders. The board recommends voting in favor of the proposed resolutions. No special situation such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is present. This is a routine corporate governance filing equivalent to a US proxy statement. The only actionable item is the upcoming shareholder meeting.
